params.body:
Netwerk drew only the 60 relations with the most projects ("Hoeveel 60"), so most of what was discussed on Bespreken never showed up in the picture.

- Every relation in the period is drawn; the "Hoeveel" picker is gone.
- Size: grows with the number of projects (as before), times 1.5 for high importance and 0.75 for low (`radius()` in `network-model.js`).
- Colour: new default "Kleur per belang": red high, green medium, light green low, grey not yet set. "Kleur per rol" and "Kleur per groep" stay. The legend under the graph follows.
- Names still show for the 15 busiest, high importance, and whatever is hovered or open.
- `Network::graph()` counts shared projects per project instead of comparing every pair of relations, so the full set stays quick. The `$limit` argument is removed.

Checked in the browser on a demo copy with 733 relations (700 generated): page loads in under a second, the graph settles in a few seconds. Relations that share fewer projects than "Lijn vanaf" with anyone sit as small dots around the edge.

Tests: 338 PHP tests pass, the network-model JS tests pass (new one for the size by importance), pint clean.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
